newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums unchanged in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums unchanged in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was directionless in quiet trade on Monday and premiums were notionally unchanged, traders said.
"The market is almost asleep," one trader said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures rose $4.50 to $221.50 a tonne on cold weather in Europe.
Traders saw a handful of enquiries but said deals were only likely at the end of the week when most players returned from holidays.
Cargo premiums were assessed notionally at Jan IPE +27/28 with barge premiums at +$25/26. Asian arbitrage remains open in the Mediterranean, where cargoes remain at around fob Med high +$5/6.
